title: Unary normalization of the derived scalar inverse mate
statement: For finite R, p:X→Y, and any fixed-scalar cochain complex P on Y, the specified derived inverse mate [def-sf-finite-scalar-pullback-comparison] agrees with the ordinary inverse mate [def-sf-finite-scalar-ordinary-pullback-comparison] after localization, via the exact-derived factor isomorphisms. Precisely, E_X(f_P);e_X(AP);Q(c_P inverse) equals alpha_P inverse;G(e_Y(P));g_(UP), where f,g are the fixed and intrinsic pullback factor isomorphisms, e_X,e_Y are realization factors, and c is the termwise ordinary mate. No tensor product or choice of tensor model occurs.

source.place: Tags 00YV, 07A4 and 07A6; Unary normalization of the derived scalar inverse mate

proof.text: The fixed inverse image is exact, so compose its left-derived-to-exact-derived isomorphism with mapDerivedCategoryFactors to construct f, without choosing any witness.

The ordinary comparison is the inverse mate of the section-normalized right comparison. The derived inverse right comparison satisfies its all-complex unit normalization. Apply the exact-derived mate formula and uniqueness of mates to identify the localized ordinary mate with the specified derived mate. Insert the two exact-derived factors to give the displayed unary equation.

theorem finiteScalarPullback_representative_factors
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ) :
    (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X R).functor.map
        ((finiteScalarFixedPullbackFactors R p).hom.app P) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X R).functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app P) =
    (finiteScalarPullbackComparison R p).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback R p).map
        ((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Y R).functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
      (proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors p (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)
        (proEtaleConstantRing X R) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison p R)).hom.app
          (((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Y R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
